headline: New companies with Chinese owners increased 2.8 times in Ukraine — Finance.ua
summary: The number of new companies with Chinese owners opened in Ukraine rose 2.8 times, according to Finance.ua. The report also cites 709 new companies with foreign owners.
why: Foreign-owned company registrations indicate investor appetite and business activity in a market, and are tracked as a signal of economic recovery.
